classificationMethod: explicit mesh name table (no material/luminance heuristic)
modifications: Wave 2 (W2-E): Object_2 (body + bow + bell + neck tube, originally fused in one primitive) was re-segmented into four primitives -- Object_2_neck, Object_2_body, Object_2_bow, Object_2_bell -- sharing the original POSITION/NORMAL accessors and material. No vertex, UV or normal data was added, removed or moved; only which triangles belong to which node changed. See scripts/segment-model.mjs (classifyTubeVertices + its header comment) for the geometric method and ATTRIBUTION.md for the CC BY modification note.

Object_2_neck.note: neck tube + mouthpiece receiver socket, split from Object_2 at local Z > 0.14 (the density gap between the thin crook and the thicker body)

Object_2_body.note: main straight tube from the tenon to the start of the bow, split from Object_2's trunk by geodesic distance from the tenon (< 30% of the tube's surface path)

Object_2_bow.note: the U-turn at the bottom of the horn, split from Object_2's trunk by geodesic distance (30%-65% of the tube's surface path)

Object_2_bell.note: the flare and rim, split from Object_2's trunk by geodesic distance (> 65% of the tube's surface path, the farthest region from the tenon)

Object_3.note: main keywork stack: touches, rods, cups, pads

Object_4.note: small fitting on the bell (brace/ring region)

Object_6.note: ligature and the neck tenon / cork end

Object_8.note: octave mechanism at the top of the body/neck receiver
